structural_findings: feature calculation, signal policy, fixed sizing, stop/target geometry and add logic are co-located in one strategy function
position size is fixed config quantity rather than explicit risk-distance/equity-risk contract
fee/spread/slippage/funding/latency budget is absent from the strategy policy contract
beam bonuses, scale-in and dip-add are embedded with base entry instead of independently owned/testable policy components
legacy return object is not an immutable lineage-bearing DecisionIntent and does not bind evidence/source/config/feature hashes

mechanism.core: price persistence after a confirmed prior-range breakout when directional structure and tradable volatility support continuation
mechanism.payer_constraint: late inventory adjustment, stop/hedge flow and trend participation can create continuation; whipsaw/range regimes are the primary failure mode
mechanism.cost_requirement: expected move must clear prospectively frozen fee+spread+slippage+funding budget

v2_policy_direction.entry: prior-window Donchian breakout plus frozen directional structure; all inputs closed-bar only
v2_policy_direction.strength: normalize breakout distance, trend alignment and move scale by volatility; do not use sign-only entry
v2_policy_direction.regime: fail closed in stale data, insufficient warmup, untradable cost/move budget, and structurally non-trending/chop state
v2_policy_direction.risk: position size derived from frozen equity-risk budget divided by stop distance, with hard exposure cap
v2_policy_direction.invalidation: breakout failure / structure violation owned by policy
v2_policy_direction.exit: base strategy owns initial invalidation/timeout; trailing/runner/partial can remain explicit policy fields but must be independently ablatable before adoption
v2_policy_direction.pyramiding: profitable-only and bounded; adverse dip-add/martingale behavior is not inherited automatically from legacy implementation

test_skeleton.planted_edge_positive_control: synthetic series with deterministic breakout continuation must produce correct side and positive policy/evaluator parity
test_skeleton.parity: StrategyPolicy DecisionIntent hash must equal evaluator-consumed DecisionIntent hash 100%
